title: Westall landing and intimidation of Mr. Greenwood

tellings.quote: little bit with the 1966 uh Westall UFO incident, the landing, when I got a hold of Mr. Greenwood,

plain: In 1966 at Westall, in Australia, a UFO is said to have landed, and a man named Mr. Greenwood is said to have been pressured into silence afterwards. James Fox, who looked into the case himself, brings it up in passing, recalling the time he managed to track down Mr. Greenwood. He gives no more detail, but he tells it as part of a pattern of witnesses being leaned on after sightings.
